sources.title: USS America (CV-66) service history
sources.basis: Prepared factual summary of Naval History and Heritage Command ship history
sources.text: The Navy commissioned USS America at Norfolk Naval Shipyard on January 23, 1965. Lawrence Heyworth Jr. was its first commanding officer.

sources.title: Mount Airy, North Carolina incorporation
sources.basis: Prepared factual summary of the city financial report, Profile of the Government
sources.text: Mount Airy became an incorporated municipality in 1885. The city is in the northwestern part of North Carolina.

sources.title: Corona, California incorporation
sources.basis: Prepared factual summary of the City of Corona Heritage Room history
sources.text: On July 13, 1896, the residents of South Riverside voted for incorporation. The community adopted the name Corona as it incorporated.
